text:
maya: quick sync — i sketched a minimal client-visible error surface for API + console. want ops + ux sanity check before i ship an RFC.

devon: short Q: are we redefining 429/503/5xx meanings or adding metadata?

maya: adding metadata. keep status codes but emit tiny hints so consoles + SDKs can badge deterministically. thinking: x-rw-reason, x-rw-retryable (true|false), x-rw-retry-hint (secs/text).

sai: header count worry. could we pack into x-rw-sc (short int) and a small freeform rnote? numeric is easy to parse.

lex: numeric SC + rnote sounds fine for infra. dashboards prefer flat tags though — ensure we map SC -> client_surface_bucket at ingress.

sofia: console needs 4 buckets: OK | THROTTLED | DEGRADED | UNAVAILABLE. copy must be <=80 chars. examples: "Rate limit reached — requests paused. Retry after {n}s or request more quota."

maya: proposed badge mapping (sketch):
- 429 + reason=quota -> THROTTLED, retryable=true, retry-hint -> Retry-After or secs
- 503 + reason=backpressure -> DEGRADED, retryable=false, no retry-hint
- 424 + reason=downstream -> UNAVAILABLE, retryable=false, retry-hint="contact support"
- 5xx generic -> UNAVAILABLE, retryable=false, retry-hint="try later"

rui: operational: for non-idempotent endpoints we must avoid advertising retry hints. require servers to set retryable=false. telemetry must record retryable as a tag.

devon: SDK note: surface headers behind a feature flag initially; show simple helper that respects x-rw-retryable.

lex: infra asks: 1) emit resolved badge as a trace/tag at ingress for queries so dashboards don't need postprocessing. 2) short-window metric for backpressure spikes so alerts can split quota vs capacity.

sofia: ux will prepare final one-liners and two A/B variants. i'll keep them concise and action-oriented.

maya: rollout plan: internal canary -> add client_surface_bucket telemetry tag -> 14-day canary -> GA. include small S3 reclassification job to backfill last 60 days so charts stay continuous.

ops-bot: preview deploy created for branch `errtax/headers-v1` — https://deploys.internal/preview/2210

rui: please log both raw header values and the resolved badge in traces for runbooks.

devon: i'll add migration + SDK shims to the RFC draft. also include docs about idempotency and server-side pseudocode.

maya: thanks all — i'll update RFC with exact header names (or SC mapping), badge buckets, telemetry tags, migration plan, and canary schedule and ping for sign-off.

ops-bot: canary scheduled 2024-11-04T04:00Z (50% traffic).
